about:
Sixto Packaging is based in Opa-locka, Florida. The company was founded by Felipe and Carmen Sixto along with their three sons, Felipe, Emilio, and Andres, and today operates with three generations of the family involved in daily operations. It is a family-owned and minority-certified flexible packaging converter.

The company prints, laminates, and converts flexible packaging into pouches, bags, and shrink sleeves entirely in-house. Its capabilities also include graphics engineering services to support design and prepress needs. All production steps are kept under one roof, allowing control over quality and turnaround.

Sixto Packaging serves the snack food, coffee, beverage, medical, personal care, household, and pet food markets, among other specialty sectors. Customers range from consumer brands to industrial packagers seeking custom flexible packaging solutions.

The company emphasizes quick lead times, a commitment it has maintained for over 40 years, and positions itself as an advocate for flexible packaging, having been featured in industry publications such as Flexible Packaging Magazine.
